/-- `request` (a JavaScript object) as the text `deus inbox` reads; a field that is `undefined` is left out. -/
def Worker.Inbox.text (request : Js) : Text :=
  let present := List.filter (fun key => Js.typeOf (Js.get request key) != "undefined") Inbox.fields
  let items := List.map (fun key => Sexp.list [Sexp.sym key, Sexp.str (Js.toText (Js.get request key))]) present
  let assets := Option.getOr (Option.map Js.toList (toOption (Js.get request "assets"))) []
  let asset := fun a => Sexp.list [Sexp.sym "asset",
    Sexp.str (Js.toText (Js.get a "hash")),
    Sexp.str (Js.toText (Js.get a "type")),
    Sexp.str (Js.toText (Js.get a "name"))]
  Sexp.print (Sexp.list (Sexp.sym "request" :: items ++ [Sexp.list (Sexp.sym "assets" :: List.map asset assets)]))
